verification_levels.code: Direct entry points, protocol validation, adapter policies and supported branches inspected; no model-wide vehicle compatibility inferred.
verification_levels.bench: Local process fixtures, Windows native application, disposable x86_64 Android 11 and 13 emulators with SELinux Enforcing.
verification_levels.vehicle: Not performed. No OEM boot partition, physical button, actuator, ARM64 injection or sleep/wake result is certified.

root_channel_checks: Executed the installer access-generation shell twice on both emulators, with only the root-owned BusyBox location substituted for the test binary.
App UID authenticated to the actual loopback Telnet service and executed id -u as root without su.
Verified UTF-8 and mixed-case data, twelve consecutive 32 KB single-line heredocs, rejection of a wrong key and successful subsequent authentication.
Verified idempotent listener start, refusal to replace a foreign listener, kernel lock recovery after a killed holder, and verified stop/restart.
First-run acknowledgment reported unreviewed firmware, microphone permission present and Accessibility connected; it did not report vehicle readiness.

Ran the official Frida 17.26.2 x86_64 injector and the pinned Java bridge only in the Controls process on API 30 and 33 under Enforcing. Verified the official ARM64 archive and binary hashes separately.
user_flow_checks: Opened voice directly from Quick access, exercised RECORD_AUDIO denial and grant, suppressed duplicate opening callbacks, and returned to the previous app after a later press on API 33.
Loaded both bundled offline voice models with native Vosk in selected instrumented tests.
On API 30, granted unknown-source access, selected a local single APK, confirmed native installation, saw its verified receipt and opened it from Installed apps.
Selected that installed app in a saved F9 tap assignment and launched it from Android Settings through the virtual hardware keyboard and Accessibility.
Cancelled the native confirmation for a local APK update; the app reported cancellation and retained the installed package.
Rendered the current Quick access, Settings, first-run result, Windows Installation and Windows Releases and logs screens; inspected actual captures.

windows.build: Optimized unsigned development build, no production Android certificate pin
windows.portable: Includes matching SDK tools, compact Java runtime, current support scripts and the pinned ARM64 injector.
windows.portable_verifier: Bundled Java and apksigner verified the current APK v2 signature.
windows.rendering: GDI and native controls with a blocking message loop; 24-second bounded diagnostic with 12 samples. Settled visible and hidden windows recorded zero paints.

limits: Prepare and install still requires OEM ADB root, a root-owned BusyBox with standalone loopback Telnet and flock, an existing root-run logcat init entry, and a writable system mount. These prerequisites were not established on a vehicle.
The Windows full preparation workflow was checked through mocks and its actual access-generation shell, not a production ARM64 device with an OEM system partition.
The development kit does not bypass production APK signing, certificate pinning or exact-firmware review. The shipped reviewed catalogs remain empty.
Cold OEM boot, sleep/wake, real microphone acoustics, OEM process restarts and physical actions require separate device checks.
API 28 must be rerun, followed by a signed release first-run check. The final APK hash was confirmed on the API 33 emulator before tests.
The API 30 stock file picker did not respond to file-row touch input in this emulator. Keyboard navigation selected the file successfully. Do not infer that vehicle file-picker touch is verified.
Injected adb input keyevent did not exercise the Accessibility assignment in this emulator. A Linux input event on its virtual hardware keyboard did launch the assigned app.
Passenger display policy, OEM freeform behavior, split/APKS handling and low-storage/model-extraction failure are not certified by the single-APK UI check.

Additional CAN camera/star/media routes, dedicated overseas navbar and login adapters, and separate Rest/Mi/BY qualification remain outstanding. Guest profiles remain unavailable for Dreamer Rest variants.
No application catalog, download catalog or store was added in this change.
